mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 75 degrees under a New Moon.

The Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-term guide focuses on housing, sustainability, and supporting our local downtown area, and you can view the full plan on the city website.

We have a busy schedule. Today you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In a recent report, on October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following an investigation that recovered a stolen weapon.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM tonight.
